title: Norman Christopher Begleys Enlistment Into Regular Army

page_data.en:
FM. 2

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
S.1. Special Branch,
REPORT
Date October 29, 19 37

Subject Norman Christopher Begley - enlistment into British Regular Army

Made by D.S. Darby Forwarded by

Relative to the communication, dated October 19, from
the Staff Officer of the Shanghai Volunteer Corps, requesting
information about a British subject, one N.C. Begley who has
applied for enlistment in the Regular Army, the following
information is now submitted.

Norman Christopher Begley who is registered at H.B.M.
Consulate-General as a British subject, was born in Hongkong
on the 15 Janua. '913 and is of British parentage. His father
Mr. A.J. Begley who is now deceased, was formerly a chief
engineer in the employ of the Indo-China Steam Navigation Company
Ltd., while his mother died in Hongkong in 1920.

Educated at Taunton School, Somersetshire, Begley was
obliged to curtail his scholastic studies for financial reasons
and returned to Shanghai in 1929 where he obtained employment
as a junior clerk in the firm of Hugh Middleton and Company,
(Insurance) Ltd. In 1930 he was dismissed from this company
because of his continued failure to conform to the rules of
timekeeping laid down by the firm. By September, 1930, Begley
was able to secure temporary employment as an audit clerk with
the Hongkong Shanghai Hotels Ltd.; in December, 1930, on the
termination of this appointment, Begley left Shanghai and
proceeded to Singapore, ostensibly in search of employment
which he was unsuccessful in obtaining.

In May 1931, Begley returned to Shanghai and in July of
the same year was appointed an audit clerk in the firm of
Thomson & Company, Chartered Accountants, which firm he continued
to serve until December 1932 when he was dismissed for indulging
in frivolity when supposedly checking the accounts of a well
known organization. Prior to this episode, Begley had become

主题 诺曼·克里斯托弗·贝格利（Norman Christopher Begley）——应征加入英国正规军

由 D.S. Darby 制作 转呈者

关于上海万国商团参谋军官于10月19日来函，请求提供一名申请加入正规军的英国臣民 N.C. Begley 的相关信息，现提交如下情报。

诺曼·克里斯托弗·贝格利在英国驻沪总领事馆注册为英国臣民，1913年1月15日出生于香港，父母均为英国人。其父 A.J. Begley 先生（已故）曾任印度支那轮船航运有限公司（Indo-China Steam Navigation Company Ltd.）的总工程师，其母于1920年在香港去世。

贝格利曾在萨默塞特郡（Somersetshire）的汤顿学校（Taunton School）就读，后因经济原因被迫中断学业，于1929年返回上海，在休·米德尔顿有限公司（Hugh Middleton and Company, (Insurance) Ltd.，保险业）受雇为初级职员。1930年，他因屡次未能遵守公司规定的考勤制度而被该公司解雇。1930年9月，贝格利得以在香港上海大酒店有限公司（Hongkong Shanghai Hotels Ltd.）获得一份审计职员的临时工作；1930年12月，随着该聘期结束，贝格利离开上海前往新加坡， ostensibly（表面上）是去寻找工作，但未能成功。

1931年5月，贝格利返回上海，同年7月被汤姆森会计师事务所（Thomson & Company, Chartered Accountants）聘为审计职员，他一直在此工作至1932年12月，当时他因在 supposedly（据称）核查一家知名机构的账目时行为轻浮而被解雇。在此事件之前，贝格利结识了

acquainted with a British subject, one C.Y. Jones, who was
operating what purported to be a debt collecting agency. On
the instigation of Jones, Begley negotiated on behalf of the
agency a loan of $500.00 with a certain Sikh moneylender, Jones
acting as guarantor. The money thus obtained was deposited
in a bank in a current account on which either of the depositors
could draw. Though this loan was ostensibly for the use of
the agency, it was in fact utilized by Jones for the settlement
of certain of his more pressing private debts. Difficulties
regarding the settlement of this loan eventually arose, the
culminating point, in so far as Begley was concerned, being
reached when the latter's former landlady took legal action
in an effort to recover arrears of rent which Begley averred
Jones had promised to pay. This action was finally settled in
a satisfactory manner. Though Begley undoubtedly was extremely
foolish to have ever permitted himself to indulge in the monetary
transactions which he did, there is little doubt that Jones,
who is possessed of an extremely plausible tongue, was primarily
responsible for Begley's difficulties.
Reverting to his normal business activities, in March
1933, Begley obtained employment in the costing department of
the Texas Company (China) Ltd., from where owing to staff
reductions, he was dismissed in September 1934. Between the
latter month and December, 1934, Begley was temporarily employed
by Reuters Ltd. for the purpose of assisting in the broadcasting
of the stock market bulletins.
From January, 1935 until June of the same year, Begley
was without regular employment; in the latter month, however,
he secured a post in the accounts department of the General

一位英国臣民 C.Y. Jones，此人经营着一家所谓的债务催收机构。在 Jones 的唆使下，贝格利代表该机构与某位锡克放贷人协商了一笔500.00美元的贷款，Jones 担任担保人。所获款项存入银行的活期账户，任一存款人均可提取。虽然这笔贷款表面上是供该机构使用，但实际上被 Jones 用于偿还其某些更为紧迫的个人债务。最终，在偿还这笔贷款方面出现了困难，就贝格利而言，事态的高潮是其前房东采取法律行动，试图追回贝格利声称 Jones 曾承诺支付的欠租。此事最终得到了令人满意的解决。尽管贝格利允许自己参与上述金钱交易无疑是极其愚蠢的，但毫无疑问，拥有极强说服力的 Jones 应对贝格利的困境负主要责任。

回归正常的商业活动后，1933年3月，贝格利在美孚石油公司（中国）有限公司（The Texas Company (China) Ltd.）的成本核算部获得职位，后因人员裁减，于1934年9月被解雇。在1934年9月至12月期间，贝格利在路透社有限公司（Reuters Ltd.）临时受雇，协助播报股市简报。

从1935年1月至同年6月，贝格利没有固定工作；但在后者月份，他在中国通用

Electric Company of China Ltd. from where he was dismissed in
September, 1936. The reason for his dismissal is said to have
been due to the lack of respect shown to his superiors.
        After another period of unemployment, in December, 1936,
Begley succeeded, in spite of keen competition, in obtaining
a post in the accounts department of the China Printing and
Finishing Company Ltd. by whom he was dismissed in September,
1937 owing to his repeated failure to settle an outstanding
account with Whiteaway, Laidlaw & Company Ltd. Since the latter
date Begley has been without employment and has been residing
at 356 Rue Bourgeat, his incidental expenses being met by a
friend of long standing, one U.V.F. Spink.
        While his dismissals from firms and organizations of good
standing tend to show that Begley lacks the requirements
necessary to enable him to hold a position of responsibility,
yet, judging by the information supplied the undersigned by
certain of his past employers, the impression gained is that
Begley's chief failing has been a marked inability to observe
the rules and discipline to which every employee in a business
of good repute must conform.
        Enquiries both in the International Settlement and in the
French Concession reveal Begley to have been not only a habitue
of the local cabarets and dance halls but also a follower of
Hai Alai and dog racing at the Auditorium and the Canidrome
respectively. To his credit, however, it must be said that
during the past year, he appears to have made a very determind
effort to free himself from the aforementioned influences.
        To sum up, as a result of an interview with the applicant,
the undersigned has formed the opinion that the primary cause of

电气股份有限公司（General Electric Company of China Ltd.）的会计部获得职位，他于1936年9月从该公司被解雇。据说他被解雇的原因是对上级缺乏尊重。

在经历另一段失业期后，1936年12月，尽管竞争激烈，贝格利仍成功在中国印刷整理有限公司（China Printing and Finishing Company Ltd.）的会计部获得职位，但因屡次未能结清对惠泰罗·莱德劳有限公司（Whiteaway, Laidlaw & Company Ltd.）的未付账款，他于1937年9月被解雇。自该日期以来，贝格利一直失业，居住在布尔热瓦路（Rue Bourgeat）356号，其日常开销由一位多年的朋友 U.V.F. Spink 资助。

虽然他从信誉良好的公司和机构被解雇的情况表明，贝格利缺乏胜任责任职位所需的素质，但是，根据一些前雇主向具名者提供的信息来看，给人的印象是，贝格利的主要缺点在于明显无法遵守任何声誉良好的商业机构中每位员工都必须 conform（遵守）的规则和纪律。

在国际租界和法租界的调查均显示，贝格利不仅是当地歌舞厅和舞厅的常客，还分别在奥迪托里姆赌场（Auditorium）和逸园跑狗场（Canidrome）追随回力球赛和赛狗。不过，值得肯定的是，在过去一年中，他似乎做出了非常坚定的努力，以摆脱上述影响。

综上所述，通过与申请人面谈，具名者认为，导致

Begley's past behaviour has been due to the entire absence
since an early age of a normal home life and the restraining
influences which such a life can be expected to exercise on an
individual. In his favour, it should be noted that Begley
is athletically minded and is actively interested in Rugby
football, and in past seasons has been a regular member of the
Association Sportive Francaise rugby team. He is a good
badminton player while his swimming is well above the standard
of the average man. Despite careful enquiry, the applicant
does not appear to poss" any vices which will not be quickly
eradicated by the discipline of the British Regular Army.
H. J. Larby.
D. S.
D.C.(Special Branch).

SHANGHAI VOLUNTEER CORPS.
Shanghai, 19th October, 193 7.

Ref: C.49/4.
To Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch, S.M.P.

CONFIDENTIAL.

Subject: N.C. BEGLEY - ENLISTMENT INTO
REGULAR ARMY.

N.C. BEGLEY, who was recently a temporary enlistment
in the Transport Company, S.V.C., has applied to enlist
in the Regular Army.
I should be grateful if you could give me any information
as to the previous character, antecedents, &c. of this man.
N.C. BEGLEY was recently employed by the China Printing
& Finishing Company and is now believed to be unemployed.

W. Luan.
Captain,
Staff Officer,
Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

J. S. Kirby
